purpose: MUST type `inference`. `families` declares which grammatical families must actually fire — asserting the verdict alone would let a right answer come from the wrong family (verification-discipline Rule 2). Each `single_signal: true` case trips EXACTLY ONE family, which is what makes `--must-fail`'s family-deletion mutants detectable: a family with no single-signal case could be deleted wholesale and every test would stay green.
